2.measure_note: This 2026 form's schedules are NATIVELY LANDSCAPE pages (poppler renders them 2184x1687), not rotated portrait sheets, so rows advance TOP-TO-BOTTOM and axis='y' - the opposite of the 2012-2024 Weber schedules in this same corpus. Rules straight from the page's own detection: horizontal rules give the row bands, vertical rules give the columns (13.85 / 42.61 / 82.42 / 92.63 = Name|Address, Address|Amount and the Amount column's own two edges); the table's LEFT edge did not register, so only the three measured column bands are listed and the Date column is deliberately not asserted. The band [16.75,19.50] is the printed column-header row, not a data row. One spurious rule at 43.27 (a text underline inside the 'Salt Lake City' address cell) was discarded: it splits what the constant ~2.73 pct pitch shows to be the single band [41.26,43.98], and the 43.98 boundary is the one the pitch and the crops agree on. PROVED with 900 dpi --value crops of bands 1 and 13 against the Amount column, reproducing 104.10 and 100.00.

3.measure_note: Same natively-landscape geometry as p2, axis='y'. Column bands are the page's own vertical rules: 4.96/14.20/39.95/49.42/76.49/86.01 = Date of Expenditure | Person or Organization | City | Purpose of Expenditure | Amount. Two bands sit between the title and the first entry and are NOT data rows: [18.29,26.31] is the two-line printed column-header row, and [26.31,29.12] is a genuinely BLANK printed grid band the filer skipped before writing the first entry. The row list therefore starts at [29.12,31.95] so that row index == entry index; the skipped blank band is recorded here rather than silently absorbed. PROVED with 900 dpi --value crops of bands 1 and 8 against the Amount column, reproducing 808.00 and 56.08.

notes: The 2026 Weber form is a DIFFERENT DOCUMENT from the 2012-2024 one: a typed 'Candidate Information' table, a 'Campaign Financial Summary' with Last Report / This Report / Cumulative Total columns, and a 'Filing Schedule (Check One)' list (May 26 - Pre-Primary Election ticked); the certification is signed and dated 5/26/2026 even though index.csv carries a blank filing date. Its Form A and Form B are NATIVELY LANDSCAPE pages - not rotated portrait sheets - so their geometry axis is 'y', unlike every earlier Weber schedule. This is a SCANNED document, NOT a Polimorphic born-digital e-filing: it has no text layer at all (pdftotext returns nothing over all three pages) and no 'Document generated with Polimorphic.com' footer, so it was vision-read as the brief directs. Redactions: the candidate's own street address and City/Zip on p1 and EVERY donor street address on p2 are BLACKED OUT BY THE COUNTY (government-applied, preserved, never recovered); the donor city/state/zip beside each bar remain printed and are what the donor_city / donor_state fields carry - so on this filing the blanks-that-aren't-there are the county's redaction, not filer omissions. No per-page SUBTOTAL, no in-kind row, no negative amount on either schedule.
